description: Sends a commercial property and/or general liability submission for a risk in CA, TX, IL, MO, WI, LA to a licensed broker at Johal Insurance Brokers, who shops it with 20+ carriers and contacts the owner, usually the same business day. Accepted only when the owner authorized it, an effective date is given, and core facts are present (per building: year built, construction, stories, square feet, building value; 5-year loss history). Requests marked price_check_only are not submitted and get the premium calculator link instead. Each accepted call creates a real submission a human works on. It does not bind coverage. Optional base64 attachments (loss runs, dec page, SOV, rent roll, photos) up to 4 MB.

attachments.description: Optional documents (≤4 MB total base64): loss runs, dec page, SOV, rent roll, photos.

contact_name.description: Human at the insured we call.

description_of_operations.description: How the property is used / what the business does.

claims_or_lawsuits.description: GL claims/lawsuits last 5 yrs or open.

locations.description: Property line: one entry per address, each with its buildings.

business_income.description: Annual gross rents / business income to insure, USD.

contents_value.description: Business personal property, USD (0 if none).

occupancy_description.description: What this building is used for, if different from the location.

outdoor_property.description: Outdoor items and values (signs, fences, carports, pool…).

stories.description: Number of stories (from the owner, never guessed).

summary.description: Every claim in last 5 years (date, type, amount, open/closed), or 'No losses in 5 years'.

notes.description: Anything else the broker should know.

owner_authorized.description: True only if the owner (or their officer/property manager) asked for this quote and agreed to be contacted by a licensed broker.

prior_cancellation.description: Any cancellation / declination / non-renewal in 3 years, and why.

purpose.description: ready_to_bind: Owner wants coverage and will bind if the terms work; renewal_shopping: Owner is shopping an upcoming renewal; new_purchase: Owner is buying or just bought the property and needs coverage at closing; uninsured_or_cancelled: Property is uninsured, cancelled or non-renewed and needs coverage now; price_check_only: Just wants a ballpark price — no intent to switch yet

requested_by_agent.description: Name of the AI agent / platform submitting.

state.description: State where the risk is located.

supplemental_answers.description: Class supplemental answers from get_submission_requirements, keyed by question.

years_in_business.description: Years in business or years owning the property.

name: submit_commercial_insurance_submission
title: Submit a commercial property / GL insurance submission to a licensed broker
